author: ClubberNugget
body:
A Walls Map with a Twist by Random_Guy

Teams:

Pink Team

Orange Team

Red Team

Lime Team

This map is unique because of a few things:

There are no diamond or iron ores in the quads

Only 5 minutes to prepare

When you break grass, you get enchantment bottles

When you kill a player, you get a diamond

I know the map is not filled with aesthetics, but most walls maps are too cluttered with aesthetics and I want it to be open for the sake of gameplay
